title: Docusaurus project-type validation matrix diagram
description: Recipe-owned generation for a clearly labeled architecture diagram showing how public-safe project-type validation evidence flows through Farmslot surfaces instead of standalone app screenshots.

read-validation-scope.intent: Use the public-safe Farmslot, AudioLab, EchoBridge, and Companion validation lanes from the demo media plan.

render-labeled-diagram.intent: Render a simplified SVG that is explicitly labeled as an architecture diagram, not a product screenshot.

verify-public-safety.intent: Verify the diagram contains only allowed public-safe aliases and no private project labels, paths, tokens, wallet data, or notifications.

publish-artifacts.intent: Publish the SVG diagram plus summary, trace, and artifact manifest.
